claim: POS-2 (QA round 5) is fixed: saving a POS item mapping replays the item's open pos_unresolved_lines through the live depletion path, and the reply says what moved. PosHubService.upsertItemMapping (apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.service.ts), the one writer every mapping path goes through (POST /pos-hub/mappings, the catalog matcher's approve, the sale-unit review), awaits replayUnresolvedLines(restaurantId, data) after its upsert and returns the row with past_sales; and clearQueuedLines is a writer of pos_unresolved_lines.resolved (resolved: true, scoped to the house and to rows still open). Before this, no code set resolved (the CELLAR-TILL-LINES-ARE-THE-TILLS-OWN-RECORD prose, corrected 2026-11-07). Recorded in ADR 0011, amendment of 2026-11-07, and tech-debt.d/2026-11-07-fix-pos-unresolved-lines-replay-on-mapping.md. Behaviour is pinned by apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.unresolved-replay.spec.ts. The verify (comments stripped) requires the replay call and the past_sales field in upsertItemMapping's body, and the resolved: true update with both .eq filters in clearQueuedLines' body. Mutation-tested: deleting the replay call, the past_sales field, `resolved: true`, or either .eq filter each exits 1.

claim: A mapping's replay touches only its own item's rows and settles each line on its own (PR #804 audit, 2026-11-07). In replayUnresolvedLinesOrThrow a fetched row is kept only when findMapping (the lookup resolveWine uses) sends its item_name and external_item_id to the mapping just saved (sameMapping), so a glass SKU and a bottle SKU sharing a name answer to their own mappings; a row the name read returned is also re-checked for case-insensitive equality, because escapeLikePattern sends `*` as `_` (PostgREST reads `*` as `%` and no escape survives it). replayOneCheck calls applyStockEffects once per queued line inside `for (const lineNo of targets)`, so a line that moved counts as applied whatever its neighbours did, and a row is cleared only when its own lines settled. Behaviour is pinned by pos-hub.unresolved-replay.spec.ts (the glass/bottle, no-shelf, neighbour-failure and `*` cases fail against PR #804's first head, db403c0f6). The verify (comments stripped) requires the sameMapping(this.findMapping( filter and the byName re-check, applyStockEffects called only inside the per-line loop, and the `*` replacement in escapeLikePattern. Mutation-tested: removing either filter, hoisting the call out of the loop, or dropping the `*` replacement each exits 1.

claim: QA round 8c's three gaps in PR #804's replay are closed (follow-up PR stacked on #806, 2026-11-07). (1) Toast-door rows are replayed: replayUnresolvedLinesOrThrow (apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.service.ts) hands a source='toast' row without is_wine to replayToastDoorRows, which books it under the door's own key toast_sale_{order}_{menuGuid} (toast.service.ts applyOrderSaleEffects), dates it by the order's toast_closed_at from its events rows, and clears a pos_order_voided order with no stock. (2) No fixed window: the item's open rows are read page after page (keyset on id, REPLAY_PAGE_ROWS each) until a short page, and REPLAY_LINE_LIMIT counts only lines a save tries to book, so 500 older rows that cannot replay no longer hide newer ones. (3) Every id list is read in slices of REPLAY_IDS_PER_READ = 100 (pos_checks by external_check_id, events by toast order guid), the size PR #803 chose for GET /wines?ids=, so a 500-check save no longer builds a 17 KB URL. Behaviour pinned by the 'replay reaches every waiting sale (QA round 8c)' block of pos-hub.unresolved-replay.spec.ts, whose fake refuses an .in() list over 16,000 encoded characters. The verify (comments stripped) requires the .gt("id", after) page cursor with the short-page stop and no .limit(REPLAY_LINE_LIMIT) read, the 100 constant with both slices and the chunked pos_checks .in(), and the replayToastDoorRows call, its toast_sale_ key and both pos_order_voided uses. Mutation-tested: each of those 11 conjuncts removed exits 1; exits 1 at origin/main.
